text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm... I have made my decision,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wish to run in this outfit in the<n>upcoming
exhibition race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf is scheduled to run in<n>an exhibition
race next week, but as<n>for her outfit...
choice_data_list: So you're going to wear that?
So you're going to wear that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Since there are no particular<n>regulations, I
wish to compete in<n>traditional archery attire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have chosen this as my signature<n>racewear, as it
represents an ideal<n>version of myself, rather than
my<n>current self.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it a garment of intent, fitting<n>for one
whose accomplishments<n>warrant a leadership
position. If I<n>wear this, my appearance will match
my title as Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Though I remain some distance fromthe top—no, it fits because I seek toclose that distance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the outfit embodies the hunt, it<n>lays bare our
true nature as<n>Umamusume. This is why I wish to
run in archery attire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I wish to kindle that fire deep inside<n>me.
choice_data_list:
So what will you be hunting, Your Imperial
Majesty?

So what will you be hunting, Your Imperial
Majesty?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I wish to kindle that fire deep inside<n>me.
choice_data_list:
So what will you be hunting, Your Imperial
Majesty?

So what will you be hunting, Your Imperial
Majesty?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A fine question. You see, one's limits<n>are always
determined by one's<n>rational self.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, when vying for first place,<n>one's
instincts alone take hold, and<n>such limitations are
abandoned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Though such a change may appear<n>too fierce and
uncivilized to reflect the<n>ideal self I spoke of
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Ritual Coordinator
text_block_list.text:
We will now commence the archery<n>ceremony!
Bows at the ready. Draw.<n>Aaaand... release!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Graaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If one is to confront the Beast of yore,<n>one must
be ready to go to war.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be worthy of my title if I<n>allowed myself
to be overwhelmed<n>and defenseless.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Creak!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm coming in. Huh, what's with the<n>getup?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rudolf. How about we have<n>another go?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I feel a chill down my spine at the<n>sight of Narita
Brian staring down<n>Symboli Rudolf like a predator
eyeing<n>its prey...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My, my. I can see the wild hunger in<n>your eyes.
Haven't you eaten?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...At any rate, be patient. Let us wait<n>for a race
before we go for one<n>other's throats.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've got a message for you from Air<n>Groove. She
says preparations have<n>been made for the
meeting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yawn... Anyway, I've told you.Geez... I can't believe she woke meup for this...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. Thank you for the heads-u—ah,<n>she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... It appears my signature<n>racewear has
fired us both up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Pick up your jaw off the floor!<n>I'll ask you
to save that surprise for<n>the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Given the chance, I'll show you an<n>even more
eye-opening performance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One that will showcase the full extent<n>of my might
as I fell the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Symboli Rudolf<n>astonishes
everyone who sees her<n>race in her archery attire.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is but a matter of time before I<n>reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There are a number of trials and<n>tribulations I must
face on the way,<n>and shooting them all down may
well<n>prove nothing more than a lofty<n>ambition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But even if I'm dismissed or ridiculed<n>as being too
big for my cleats, my aim<n>shall be true, and I shall
move ever<n>upward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And should I succeed in drawing near<n>that
summit...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall use these very legs to chase<n>down
whoever stands there.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I accompany Symboli<n>Rudolf to the
track for a test run of her<n>new racewear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that sounds like a good idea.
Heeey!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hi, Rudolf. Got some time?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If so, you wanna race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... Ahahaha. Why not, C.B?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I shall meet you at the starting line. Or<n>perhaps
you'd rather I escort you to<n>the track?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Those eyes... You've sure<n>got spark,
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, how flattering to hear that from<n>you. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so, the race begins...

text_block_list.name: Rudolf and C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah! Whooo!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
They both tear across the track. The<n>tension in the
air feels nothing like the<n>atmosphere you'd expect
at a<n>practice run.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The intensity of their neck-and-neck<n>race shakes
me to my very core.
